mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 89 degrees, feeling like 94, near the Verona Area High School.

The City of Verona has officially installed a new seven foot tall public art sculpture titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics at Century School Park. This piece was created by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland and reflects traditional Tai Chi movements.

There is plenty to do today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, and trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co. tomorrow.
On Saturday, August 30, officers were dispatched to the 800 block of North Edge Trail for a witnessed and intentional smashing of a vehicle window.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open for business and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
